steps.action: Run cargo run -p katla_gfx --example picking_validation --features validation
steps.observed: Compilation failed with 7 errors. Examples not updated for GpuAllocator wrapper (borrow_mut not accessible without BorrowMut trait import) and Result propagation changes (begin_command_buffer now returns Result).

steps.action: Run cargo run -p katla_gfx --example outline_validation --features validation
steps.observed: Compilation failed with 85 errors. Same root causes as picking_validation plus additional mismatched type errors from VulkanContext wrapped in Rc<Result<...>>.

pickingValidationErrors: E0599: no method 'vk_command_buffer' on Result<CommandBuffer, RendererError> (line 339)
outlineValidationErrors: E0599: no method 'borrow_mut' on GpuAllocator (multiple lines)
E0609: no field 'allocator' on Rc<Result<VulkanContext, ...>> (multiple lines)
E0308: mismatched types throughout - context is Rc<Result<...>> not &VulkanContext

assertions.issues: Both picking_validation and outline_validation examples fail to compile due to API changes from VAL-ROBUST-001 (Result propagation) and VAL-ROBUST-002 (GpuAllocator wrapper). The examples were not updated to match the new API signatures: (1) GpuAllocator no longer exposes borrow_mut() directly - needs BorrowMut trait import or new method, (2) begin_command_buffer() now returns Result<CommandBuffer, RendererError> instead of CommandBuffer, (3) VulkanContext initialization changed to wrap in Rc<Result<...>> which the examples don't unwrap.
